# Akoro Documentation

> Akoro is an education platform with learner, instructor, school and admin
> applications, an AI protégé/agent runtime, a library and extraction pipeline,
> courses and media, curriculum and assessments, and a school ERP. This
> repository is the canonical platform knowledge base.

Status: all categories populated (2026-11-26). Availability comes from
`capability-registry.yaml`; do not infer it from prose.

## Notes

- Public docs are an allow-listed subset of this repository.
- Planned capabilities are not callable.
- Documentation explains permissions; the backend enforces them.
- Use only demo accounts and sandbox data in examples.
